name: linkedin-post-writing
description: A proven 9-step process for writing lead-generating LinkedIn posts in the writer's OWN voice. Takes ONE idea through the full pipeline: idea → post type (expert/personal) → format → angle → meat+problem → body (angle-driven) → summary → trailer → humanize → aggressive layout. Voice, audience (ICP), and language are the user's inputs, collected up front, so any user can install it and write in their own voice. Self-contained: humanize and formatting rules ship inside the skill (no external skill dependencies). NOT for cold email sequences or content-idea calendars — this skill finalizes one publish-ready post.
